entities.name: Gitte-Yatay Mountains
entities.description: Mountain range east of Madara's main lands, a source of red mana.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: Land east of which the Gitte-Yatay mountains lie.

entities.name: Suido River
entities.description: River whose spring lies in the Gitte-Yatay range.

entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: Group whose headquarters were in the mountains.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Cast the Meteor Hammer spell on the Imperial Shrine during the Madara-Edemi War.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War during which the Imperial Shrine was destroyed.

entities.name: Imperial Shrine
entities.description: Shrine destroyed by Tetsuo Umezawa's Meteor Hammer.

events.summary: During the Madara-Edemi War, Tetsuo Umezawa destroyed the Imperial Shrine with Meteor Hammer, splitting the mountains into northern and southern chains.
events.quote: This also blasted a hole through the Gitte-Yatay Mountains, separating them into a northern and southern chain.

relations.quote: The headquarters of the Kentsu were located in this mountain range.
